What's On Tap At Ballard

Citra Fresh Hop Fiend IPA (2026) - Perrault Farms

ABV: 6.80% IBU: Unknown SRM: 4.00 
The 8th in our 2026 Fresh Hop Fiend series, Citra Fresh Hop Fiend is packed with 300 lbs. per batch of Citra fresh hops from our friends at Perrault Farms in Toppenish, WA. Citra brings aromas of citrus, tropical fruit and stone fruit. Drink it fast and fresh!


CATEGORIES: IPA, Northwest, Fresh Hop, Traditionally Fall

Dolcita Fresh Hop Fiend Hazy IPA-Perrault Farms

ABV: 6.30% SRM: 4.00 
The 8th in our 2026 Fresh Hop Fiend series, Dolcita Fresh Hop Fiend Hazy is packed with 300 lbs. per batch of Dolcita fresh hops from our friends at Perrault Farms in Toppenish, WA. Dolcita brings aromas of peach and stone fruit. Drink it fast and fresh!

CATEGORIES: Hazy, IPA, Fresh Hop, Hop Driven

Thora Fresh Hop Fiend-CLS Farms

ABV: 6.90% IBU: Unknown SRM: 4.00 
The 6th in our 2026 Fresh Hop Fiend Series, Thora Fresh Hop Fiend is packed with 300 lbs per batch of Thora Fresh Hops from our friends at CLS Farms in Moxee, WA. Thora brings aromas of grapefruit, guava and passionfruit. Drink it fast and fresh!

CATEGORIES: IPA, Fresh Hop, Hop Driven

Bavarian Hefeweizen

ABV: 5.00% IBU: 13.00 SRM: 4.00 
Close your eyes, take a sip of this beer and you’re sure to be transported to a tree-lined, sun-speckled biergarten in Munich. We honor tradition by brewing this beer using decoction mashing techniques and fermenting with a German yeast strain that imparts prominent banana and clove notes. The wheat gives this beer a crisp, slightly tart, refreshing finish. AWARDS: 2019 Gold Medal-North American Brewers Association, 2016 Gold Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2015 Silver Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2014 Gold Medal-WA Beer Awards

CATEGORIES: Bavarian, Wheat, Traditionally Spring, Traditionally Summer, Yeast Driven, Malt Driven

German Style Pilsner

ABV: 5.20% IBU: 37.00 SRM: 3.00 
Imported German 2-row barley and Roy Farms Adeena hops give this German-style pils its crisp, clean character. Warning: this beer's subtle grain sweetness, spicy hop aroma and refreshingly dry, hop-forward finish may elicit a spontaneous Prost!
AWARDS: 2025, Gold Medal - Washington Beer Awards | 2017 Silver Medal-SIP NW Best of the NW

CATEGORIES: German, Lager, Pilsner, Water Driven, Malt Driven

Cervecita Mexican Lager

ABV: 4.80% IBU: 14.00 SRM: 2.00 
Our Mexican Lager is perfect for sunny days on the patio or the beach...preferably in flip flops. Since we can't guarantee sunny days in Seattle, we kept this lager light and bright and irresistibly crushable, sunshine not required. Salud! Awards: Bronze Medal Washington Beer Awards 2025 | Gold Medal Washington Beer Awards 2022.

CATEGORIES: Lager, Traditionally Summer, Water Driven, Malt Driven

In the Meantime IPA

ABV: 6.30% IBU: 41.00 SRM: 4.00 
Let's make plans to hang with friends, take vacations, see a show, sit at a bar and...well... look forward to the good times to come, but in the meantime, feel free to slow your roll, relax your mind and enjoy this tropical fruit, citrus and mango-full IPA. Hops: Galaxy, Citra, Nelson, Mosaic


CATEGORIES: IPA, Northwest, Hop Driven

Cervecita Negra

ABV: 4.80% IBU: 20.00 SRM: 12.00 
This crisp and flavorful cousin to our Cervecita is built on a base of German Pilsner and Vienna malts for a touch more malt complexity and a darker color. Delightfully different, yet equally refreshing and delicious.

CATEGORIES: Lager

Yakima Bound IPA

ABV: 6.80% IBU: 49.00 SRM: 4.00 
We are always thinking about our hop friends in Yakima, but they are especially on our minds right now during harvest season. With one, maybe two trips a week to pick up fresh hops, we get to see their hard working, smiling faces and it's the highlight of late summer for us. Yakima Bound is filled with aromas and flavors of grapefruit, stone fruit and orange for a pint of west coast goodness. Cheers to you, Yakima!

CATEGORIES: IPA, Northwest, Hop Driven

Stouporo Japanese Style Lager

ABV: 4.50% IBU: 13.00 SRM: 2.00 
A supremely refreshing lager brewed with pilsner malt and rice solids for a crisp, refreshing beer experience. For a touch of peach and apricot aroma, we added New Zealand Wai-iti hops in the dry hop and whirlpool.

CATEGORIES: Lager, Yeast Driven, Malt Driven

Mosaic Pale Ale

ABV: 5.30% IBU: 39.00 SRM: 5.00 
A highly drinkable, hop forward beer with a classic American Pale Ale malt bill. Heavy handed Mosaic dry hopping gives this beer a nose packed full of citrus and mango. Up front aroma, balanced bittering and a moderate body just beg for another taste...and another...and another...
AWARDS: 2021 Silver Medal-Great American Beer Festival, 2019 Silver Medal-SIP NW Best of the Northwest, 2019 Bronze Medal-Best of Craft Beer Awards, 2018 Silver Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2017 Judges Pick-SIP NW Best of the NW

CATEGORIES: Northwest, Pale, Hop Driven

West Coast Pale

ABV: 5.50% IBU: 52.00 SRM: 3.00 
Citra, Simcoe and Mosaic hops and a 2-row malt base. Straight up delicious!

CATEGORIES: Pale, Hop Driven

Citra IPA

ABV: 5.90% IBU: 50.00 SRM: 3.00 
We like to call this one Sunshine In a Glass ... or Sunshine In Your Belly because it won't stay in that glass long. Our Citra® IPA is designed to be light and bright in both color and body. Your first sniff will elicit images of tropical fruit and citrus thanks to a healthy dose of Citra® hops. Enjoy a pint of this and you might just find yourself gazing skyward, pondering how in the heck sunshine made its way into your glass.
AWARDS: 2019 Silver Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2019 Bronze Medal-Best of Craft Beer Awards, Silver Medal- SIP NW Best of the NW, 2015 Silver Medal-WA Beer Awards

CATEGORIES: IPA, Northwest, Hop Driven

Jimothy Juice Hazy IPA

ABV: 7.00% IBU: 45.00 SRM: 4.00 
We love Jimothy and the flash of joy he brought to our city and the WORLD. We might not be the first to brew a beer with Jimothy's name, but we love him the most. Well maybe not the most, but we love him a lot! We brewed this hazy IPA with Citra Cryo, Nelson Sauvin and Galaxy. It's got citrus, white grape and passionfruit aromas that have nothing to do with small raccoons, but make a really delicious beer. So to Jimothy, thank you for bringing us happiness and hope. Short on length, but long on heart. That's our Jimothy.


CATEGORIES: Hazy

Dunkelweizen

ABV: 5.00% IBU: 13.00 SRM: 17.00 
This is a rich, malty wheat beer brewed using traditional German decoction methods. A base of 2-row, wheat, pilsner and Munich malts were supplemented with rich specialty malts like Chocolate and Special Aromatic for a hearty cool season sipper. Fermentation with a German Hefeweizen yeast adds further complexity with notes of banana and clove.

CATEGORIES: Bavarian, Yeast Driven, Malt Driven

NW Red

ABV: 5.00% IBU: 40.00 SRM: 12.00 
Our Northwest Red Ale provides a distinctly Northwest hop character balanced with a restrained malt sweetness. We use 2 Row barley along with Best Maltz Red X to create a rich, red color and a smooth, satisfying taste. A hint of chocolate seals the deal.
AWARDS: 2021 Silver Medal-Great American Beer Festival

CATEGORIES: Northwest, Hop Driven, Malt Driven

Robust Porter

ABV: 6.20% IBU: 45.00 SRM: 31.00 
Rich in color and character, our robust porter conjures up memories of decadent chocolate treats dipped in coffee. Hints of dark chocolate, roasted coffee and light malty sweetness are the result of a complex malt profile including chocolate malt, roasted wheat and roasted rye.

AWARDS: 2019 Judges Pick-SIP NW Best of the Northwest, 2019 Silver Medal - North American Brewers Association, 2018 Silver Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2017 Double Gold Medal-Sip NW Best of the NW, 2017 Gold Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2016 Silver Medal-WA Beer Awards, 2014 Silver Medal World Beer Cup & WA Beer Awards



CATEGORIES: Northwest, Porter, Malt Driven

Festbier

ABV: 6.10% IBU: 4.00 SRM: 20.00 


CATEGORIES: German, Lager, Yeast Driven, Malt Driven

Sour Pop Berry Blend

ABV: 4.90% IBU: 8.00 SRM: 3.00 
Our rotating fruited sour series will showcase a variety of fruits in a tart and refreshing beer. We use Lachancea yeast, an exciting yeast that both produces lactic acid and ferments maltose, alongside our house ale yeast. This version is a berry blend with raspberry and Key Lime!

CATEGORIES: Sour

Yonder Cider - Hot Yonder Summer

ABV: 6.90% 

Originally crafted as a small-batch collaboration with our buddies at Chucks Hop Shop (formally known as Hot Chuck Summer) we bring you a cider that's packed with the flavors of juicy peach, zesty lemon and refreshing mint, this cider is the ultimate thirst-quencher for those sun-soaked days. Tart and juicy all at the same time, this one has our favorite flavors of the season packed into one seriously fun can. ⁠

6.9% ABV



CATEGORIES: Sour

Wine - Mark Ryan Winery
